solve_zero_sum_matrix_game: solve a zero-sum matrix game using linear programming and return equilibrium strategies and values
test_dominance_check: test whether a strategy is strictly, weakly, or very weakly dominated in a matrix game
test_dominance_mixture: test finding a mixed strategy that dominates a pure strategy and returns the mixture weights
test_iterated_dominance: run iterated dominance elimination on a matrix game to reduce it to surviving strategies
test_iterated_dominance_ordering: test that strict dominance leaves more strategies than weak dominance which leaves more than very weak dominance
